When the bars begin shrinking, the lines are coming back toward each other, and momentum is starting to fade.
When the MACD line crosses downward through the Signal line, momentum is shifting in the opposite direction, which is often read as a signal to sell or close an existing buy trade.
If the bars have been growing for a while and then begin to shrink, momentum may be fading – even if the price has not yet reversed.
